newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian base metals steady in sluggish trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian base metals steady in sluggish trade.

text.p: Base metals finished steady on Friday after sluggish industrial demand was matched by thin arrivals, dealers said.
Ready copper was steady at 12,500 rupees per quintal, tin at 34,500 rupees and nickel at 36,800 rupees in light activity.
Aluminium was unchanged at 7,200 rupees per quintal, zinc at 6,500 rupees and lead at 4,400 rupees.
The market was closed on Thursday as traders downed shutters in protest against heavy tax burden.
